//: Persisted/remote identifiers that survive the Kosmos→Mundus rebrand (KOS-266). Each pattern is a case-insensitive JS regex; a kosmos|kepler match is legal only when it sits inside one of these pattern occurrences, on a line marked `MIGRATION(KOS-267)`, or in a file listed under `files`. Human-readable doc: docs/brand-legacy-identifiers.md.

patterns.reason: GitHub org for cortex + sibling repos (component pins, updater channel makekosmos/desktop, imago/kosmos-gpui-kit deps, docs links). Org rename is a separate change; GitHub redirects keep old URLs working.
Signed-catalog package ids and canonical type ids persisted in user databases (ark.db objects/migration objects). KOS-265 replaces them.
Signing key id baked into signed catalogs on package-index and into users' installed trust state. KOS-265 rotates it.
`publisher: "kosmos"` field of signed package manifests (package_manifest.rs validates it) and the `extensions.kosmos` key persisted in user ARK objects. KOS-265.
Pinned external crate/repository (manager-gpui dependency); renamed upstream separately.
HTTP header names (x-kosmos-client-pid, x-kosmos-api-version, …) sent by pinned component builds and kosmos-gpui-kit — the Engine must keep accepting them until the pins move.
Media types (application/vnd.kosmos.richtext+json) persisted inside user ARK objects.
Published npm scope for @kosmos/ark / @kosmos/visuals and the WS client_class value `@kosmos/ark` sent by existing clients.
Package archive host used by the signed catalog and persisted install records; also the DNS zone, renamed with the domain.
JSON field keys persisted in user ARK objects (extensions.kosmos) and package.json-adjacent pin structures of other repos.
Electron-era install dir (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\kepler-shell) and settings file (kepler-shell-settings.json) handled by the KOS-267 migration.
Pre-0.10 Engine binary name; running 0.9.x Engines and their Run values are matched by migration code.
Legacy hosts-file markers (`# === kepler-focus BEGIN/END ===`) and the legacy service pipe \\.\\pipe\\kepler-focus-svc left by installed services.
Files a 0.9.x-era Engine wrote into %APPDATA%\Kosmos that travel with the renamed directory and must still be recognised.
Service names of installed previous-generation privileged services; kept for lookup/removal until the elevated KOS-267 migration completes on every machine.
Legacy standalone-Engine uninstall key, Run value, and Start Menu shortcut names handled by the installer migration.
Legacy HKCU Run value names / Electron app ids from earlier installer generations.
Binary/shortcut names of previous product generations that installer and kill-lists must still reference.
Legacy user-data/install paths (%APPDATA%\Kosmos, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kosmos\Engine, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Kosmos) referenced by migration code and migration tests.
product id inside engine-manifest.json files installed by 0.9.x-era installers; the install script must keep validating it.
Legacy environment variable names kept readable as migration fallbacks (MUNDUS_* is primary) or sent to pinned sibling builds that still read them.

Persisted identifiers inside user data and wire/catalog contracts: deterministic link-hash seeds, kosmos-local*:// URL schemes written into notes, the extensions.kosmos JSON key, the kosmos-host manifest target runtime, the kosmos-desktop WS client class, the kosmos-kepler keyring service (holds user credentials), and the kepler-fallback device id already written on existing machines.
The window.kosmosApp / window.kepler page globals are the persisted host API that shipped .kspkg apps (Arcadia) call — the launch shim must expose the same names until packaged apps move.
